questions.question: What is the opening and closing refrain of Psalm 8?
options: Give thanks unto the LORD, for his great mercy endures forever
Bless the LORD, O my soul, and all that is within me
O LORD, our Lord, how majestic is your name in all the earth
The LORD is my shepherd, I shall not be in want
questions.answer: O LORD, our Lord, how majestic is your name in all the earth

questions.question: What does David ask, gazing at the heavens?
options: Where were the heavens before the world?
What is man that you are mindful of him?
Who set the stars in their courses on high?
Why have you made the night so dark?
questions.answer: What is man that you are mindful of him?
